biotools.summary: ComplexHeatmap is an R package providing a highly flexible way to arrange multiple heatmaps and supports various annotation graphics for complex visualization of data associations. It allows for the efficient discovery of patterns and connections in diverse datasets within bioinformatics and other related fields.
